$$\frac{(1+\sqrt{2})(2-\sqrt{3})}{(2+\sqrt{3})(2-\sqrt{3})} = \frac{2 - \sqrt{3} + 2\sqrt{2} - \sqrt{6}}{4-3} = 2 + 2\sqrt{2} - \sqrt{3} - \sqrt{6}.$$

**Matching the form.** Group the terms as $2(1+\sqrt{2}) - (\sqrt{3}+\sqrt{6})$. This gives $A=2$, $B=2$, $C=3$, $D=6$, so $A+B+C+D = 13$.
